learning_outcomes.text: Acquaint students with the arrangement, principle action, theory, characteristics and research methods of transformers and direct current machines.

syllabus_topics: General issues of the electrical machines theory
Structure and principle action of direct current machines
Inducing electromotive force in the armature windings
Types of direct current generators and motors
Characteristics of direct current generators and motors
Winding and group connection of transformers
assessment_rules: The final examination mark depends on the mark received on the laboratory exercise. The exam is conducted in written form and consists of two subject questions.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
